faults.page says: The cited page is the 2011 charter in the edition of 3 September 2019 on a third-party legal-text site (rulaws.ru); it does not show the text is still in force. Decree No. 282 of 14 March 2020 amended points 6, 7, 25 and 26 (adding a president, appointed by the Government on the Ministry's proposal), so the cited edition is superseded and the amending text is not cited.
The latest text read is the 14 March 2020 amending decree.

faults.stored: Governance: points 2 to 7 of the charter approved by Government decree No. 984 of 29 November 2011 (edition of 3 September 2019) give the Russian Federation as founder, the Government appointing the general director, and the Ministry of Culture approving large transactions and disposals of property. Red tape: the Delovoy Peterburg article of 23 May 2019 reporting the Accounts Chamber inspection.
faults.page says: Names the 2019 edition as the text in force; the director clause now sits in point 25 as amended in 2020.
